_comment: Developer presets (testing only, never save slots). Each starts a fresh game from a recommended build, applies a world-state stage captured from a real bot playthrough (data/dev_stages.json, regenerated by tools/godot/gen_dev_stages.tscn), then the overrides below. 'level' applies Recommended level-ups to every roster member. 'adopt' pre-adopts a prestige variant; otherwise the specialization is chosen in Character -> Specialize.

prestige_bulwark.name: Prestige: Bulwark Sentinel (Mercy Warden)
prestige_bulwark.desc: Level 6 Vanguard at Mercy +50, eligible for the Warden family's Mercy variant. Engineering, Sentinel post ahead.

prestige_iron_marshal.name: Prestige: Iron Marshal (Dominion Warden)
prestige_iron_marshal.desc: Level 6 Vanguard at Dominion -50, eligible for the Warden family's Dominion variant. Engineering, Sentinel post ahead.

prestige_lumen_weaver.name: Prestige: Lumen Weaver (Mercy Weaver)
prestige_lumen_weaver.desc: Level 6 Adept at Mercy +50 with five or more powers. Archive hold, reclaimer squad ahead.

prestige_void_cantor.name: Prestige: Void Cantor (Dominion Weaver)
prestige_void_cantor.desc: Level 6 Adept at Dominion -50 with Arc Lance. Archive hold, reclaimer squad ahead.

prestige_ghost_envoy.name: Prestige: Ghost Envoy (Mercy Shade)
prestige_ghost_envoy.desc: Level 6 Operative at Mercy +50 with 6+ Stealth and Security. Engineering, Sentinel post ahead.

prestige_night_broker.name: Prestige: Night Broker (Dominion Shade)
prestige_night_broker.desc: Level 6 Operative at Dominion -50 with 6+ Stealth and Computer Use. Engineering, Sentinel post ahead.

iona_training.name: Iona's Resonance training (ready)
iona_training.desc: Level 3 Vanguard in the command chamber with Iona at influence 75 who has felt your Resonance. Party -> Talk to Iona -> 'Resonance training'.

jump_checkpoint.name: Jump: forward checkpoint
jump_checkpoint.desc: Level 1 Vanguard with Iona at the security checkpoint (credential, terminal, crawlway or combat).

jump_engineering.name: Jump: engineering loop
jump_engineering.desc: Level 2 Vanguard with both companions entering engineering (pumps, plates, Sentinel post, hatch).

jump_archive.name: Jump: archive hold
jump_archive.desc: Level 3 Vanguard with both companions entering the archive hold (reclaimers, Senna, archive index).

jump_command.name: Jump: command chamber
jump_command.desc: Level 3 Vanguard with both companions at Commander Varr (launch decision, WARDEN core).

jump_bay.name: Jump: evacuation bay
jump_bay.desc: Level 4 Vanguard with both companions entering Bay 2 (Marshal Quill standoff, launch, turret).
